title: Strong transport noise prevents self-intersection in 2D fluid-structure interaction
summary: We consider the interaction of a viscous incompressible fluid with a flexible elastic shell occupying the boundary of the fluid's domain in two space dimensions. The shell is modelled by a perfectly elastic linearised beam equation. It is an open problem in fluid-structure interaction, even for the idealised case of a perfectly elastic plate, if a self-intersection of the structure can be excluded in the long run. We show that by adding a physically well-motived and sufficiently strong transport noise in the structure equation, the self-intersection does not occur before any given end-time…
